title_short: Nila & Jennifer · Electric Bill or Her Drugs
headline: A mom had to choose between the electric bill and her daughter's medicine. Family Reach helped her daughter finish college.
story: Nila was a full-time biology student who walked miles every day. Then cancer, and her mom Jennifer's plans “blew up”. Nila stayed in school through treatment. She could not study full time, her financial aid changed, and a tuition bill came. Family Reach helped pay it off, and she graduates in May.
Open on Jennifer's hard question. End on Nila: healing means finding your happiness again. Warm and hopeful. This is a shorter cut of your approved long-form.
